statements.q: CREATE TABLE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" ("_id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "_uid" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, "_createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NULL DEFAULT NULL, "_updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NULL DEFAULT NULL, "title" VARCHAR(128) NULL, "count" INTEGER NULL, "price" DOUBLE PRECISION NULL, "active" BOOLEAN NULL, "tags" JSONB NULL, "note" VARCHAR(256) NULL, "date" TIMESTAMP(3) NULL, "loc" GEOMETRY(POINT, 4326) NULL, "_permissions" JSONB NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("_id")); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ns_docs_uid" ON "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" ("_uid" COLLATE utf8_ci_ai); CREATE INDEX "ns_docs_created" ON "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" ("_createdAt"); CREATE INDEX "ns_docs_updated" ON "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" ("_updatedAt"); CREATE INDEX "ns_docs_permissions" ON "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" USING GIN ("_permissions")

CREATE TABLE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs_perms" ("_id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "_tenant" INTEGER NULL DEFAULT NULL, "_type" VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, "_permission" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, "_document" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("_id")); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ns_docs_ukey" ON "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs_perms" USING BTREE ("_document" COLLATE utf8_ci_ai, "_type", "_permission"); CREATE INDEX "ns_docs_permission" ON "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs_perms" USING BTREE ("_permission", "_type")

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = ?::jsonb || COALESCE("tags", '[]'::jsonb), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = (
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY idx)
                    FROM (
                        SELECT value, idx
                        FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") WITH ORDINALITY AS t(value, idx)
                        WHERE idx - 1 < ?
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT ?::jsonb AS value, ? + 1 AS idx
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT value, idx + 1
                        FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") WITH ORDINALITY AS t(value, idx)
                        WHERE idx - 1 >= ?
                    ) AS combined
                ), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = COALESCE((
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(value)
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") AS value
                    WHERE value != ?::jsonb
                ), '[]'::jsonb), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = COALESCE((
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT value)
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") AS value
                ), '[]'::jsonb), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = COALESCE((
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(value)
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") AS value
                    WHERE value IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements(?::jsonb))
                ), '[]'::jsonb), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = COALESCE((
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(value)
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") AS value
                    WHERE value NOT IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements(?::jsonb))
                ), '[]'::jsonb), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = COALESCE((
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(value)
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") AS value
                    WHERE CASE ?
                        WHEN 'equal' THEN value = ?::jsonb
                        WHEN 'notEqual' THEN value != ?::jsonb
                        WHEN 'greaterThan' THEN (value::text)::numeric > trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'greaterThanEqual' THEN (value::text)::numeric >= trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'lessThan' THEN (value::text)::numeric < trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'lessThanEqual' THEN (value::text)::numeric <= trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'isNull' THEN value = 'null'::jsonb
                        WHEN 'isNotNull' THEN value != 'null'::jsonb
                        ELSE TRUE
                    END
                ), '[]'::jsonb), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)

UPDATE "bdocs_postgres"."ns_docs" SET "title" = ?, "count" = ?, "price" = ?, "active" = ?, "note" = ?, "date" = ?, "_createdAt" = ?, "_updatedAt" = ?, "_permissions" = ?, "tags" = COALESCE((
                    SELECT jsonb_agg(value)
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements("tags") AS value
                    WHERE CASE ?
                        WHEN 'equal' THEN value = ?::jsonb
                        WHEN 'notEqual' THEN value != ?::jsonb
                        WHEN 'greaterThan' THEN (value::text)::numeric > trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'greaterThanEqual' THEN (value::text)::numeric >= trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'lessThan' THEN (value::text)::numeric < trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'lessThanEqual' THEN (value::text)::numeric <= trim(both '"' from ?::text)::numeric
                        WHEN 'isNull' THEN value = 'null'::jsonb
                        WHEN 'isNotNull' THEN value != 'null'::jsonb
                        ELSE TRUE
                    END
                ), '[]'::jsonb), "loc" = ST_GeomFromText(?, 4326) WHERE "_id" IN (?)
